provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Marks the co-participant in a mutual action: both sides take part in the same event, which is why it is the particle of 話す, 相談する, 結婚する and けんかする. に points one way at a recipient, so 先生に相談する asks for advice while 先生と相談する works the problem out together, and with 結婚する or けんかする に is impossible. The other lanes of と are the exhaustive list (パンと卵), the conditional (春が来ると, 窓を開けると), and the written quotative との (中止との連絡).

examples.ruby: 昼休[ひるやす]みに、隣[となり]のクラスの子[こ]と将棋[しょうぎ]で勝負[しょうぶ]した。
examples.english: At lunch break I took on the kid from the next class at shogi.

examples.ruby: 来月[らいげつ]、妹[いもうと]は同僚[どうりょう]と結婚[けっこん]することになった。
examples.english: Next month my little sister is marrying a coworker.

examples.ruby: 家族[かぞく]とじっくり相談[そうだん]してから決[き]めます。
examples.english: I'll make up my mind after talking it through properly with my family.

patterns.usage_note: Points an act one way at the other party: the person told, asked, handed something, or complained to (親に言う, あいつに頼む, 監督に伝える). Sibling lanes take an attitude aimed at someone (子供に優しい), the source something comes from (親方に教わる), a destination (東京に戻る), and the one who can or knows (俺には無理だ). Compare と, which makes the other person a partner in the act (友達と話す) rather than its target.

examples.ruby: こんな話[はなし]、親[おや]にゃとても言[い]えないよ。
examples.english: There's no way on earth I could tell my folks something like this.

examples.ruby: 結果[けっか]は監督[かんとく]にゃ俺[おれ]から伝[つた]えておくよ。
examples.english: I'll be the one to tell the coach the result, at any rate.

examples.ruby: あいつにゃ何[なに]を頼[たの]んでも無駄[むだ]だと思[おも]う。
examples.english: Asking that guy for anything is a waste of breath, if you ask me.
